answer: The tide register is checked at draw time, relic lists the eligible set, and opal seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 39 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary burns for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 39 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 78 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
